import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

def generate_frames():
    output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_happy"
    if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
        os.makedirs(output_dir)

    width, height = 1920, 1080
    num_frames = 60

    for i in range(num_frames):
        # Create a white canvas
        img = Image.new("RGB", (width, height), "white")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

        # Draw a blackboard
        board_rect = [100, 150, 1100, 850]
        draw.rectangle(board_rect, fill=(40, 40, 40), outline="black", width=10)
        draw.rectangle([110, 160, 1090, 840], outline=(60, 60, 60), width=5)
        
        # Add some writing on the board
        draw.text((200, 300), "E = mc^2", fill="white", font_size=100)
        draw.text((200, 450), "Python PIL Animation", fill="white", font_size=70)
        draw.text((200, 600), "Happy Stickman", fill="white", font_size=70)

        # Draw stickman
        head_center_x = 1350
        head_center_y = 400
        head_radius = 80

        # Head
        draw.ellipse(
            [head_center_x - head_radius, head_center_y - head_radius,
             head_center_x + head_radius, head_center_y + head_radius],
            outline="black", width=10
        )

        # Happy Face
        # Eyes
        eye_radius = 8
        draw.ellipse([head_center_x - 30 - eye_radius, head_center_y - 20 - eye_radius,
                      head_center_x - 30 + eye_radius, head_center_y - 20 + eye_radius], fill="black")
        draw.ellipse([head_center_x + 30 - eye_radius, head_center_y - 20 - eye_radius,
                      head_center_x + 30 + eye_radius, head_center_y - 20 + eye_radius], fill="black")
        
        # Smile
        smile_bbox = [head_center_x - 40, head_center_y - 10, head_center_x + 40, head_center_y + 40]
        draw.arc(smile_bbox, start=20, end=160, fill="black", width=8)

        # Body
        body_top_y = head_center_y + head_radius
        body_bottom_y = body_top_y + 300
        draw.line([head_center_x, body_top_y, head_center_x, body_bottom_y], fill="black", width=10)

        # Legs
        draw.line([head_center_x, body_bottom_y, head_center_x - 100, body_bottom_y + 200], fill="black", width=10)
        draw.line([head_center_x, body_bottom_y, head_center_x + 100, body_bottom_y + 200], fill="black", width=10)

        # Right Arm (resting)
        shoulder_y = body_top_y + 50
        draw.line([head_center_x, shoulder_y, head_center_x + 100, shoulder_y + 150], fill="black", width=10)

        # Left Arm (pointing at board, animated)
        # Base angle is pointing left (pi), oscillating slightly
        arm_length = 200
        angle = math.pi + math.sin(i / num_frames * 2 * math.pi) * 0.3
        
        end_x = head_center_x + arm_length * math.cos(angle)
        end_y = shoulder_y + arm_length * math.sin(angle)

        draw.line([head_center_x, shoulder_y, end_x, end_y], fill="black", width=10)

        # Save frame
        frame_filename = os.path.join(output_dir, f"frame_{i:04d}.png")
        img.save(frame_filename)
        print(f"Generated {frame_filename}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    generate_frames()
